checks.title: Keyboard-only essential workflows
evidence: skip links [A11Y-01, A11Y-02]: first Tab stop is the revealed skip link; Enter moved focus to #cell-canvas and one more Tab reached the Cell editor (source)
drawer [NAV-03, A11Y-02]: drawer opened by tab with heading focus and an inert workspace; Escape closed it and restored #open-document-nav

search and outline [NAV-03, NAV-02]: search filtered the outline only (1 of 4 entries, 4 Cells rendered) and reported the origin, announcing "1 matching Cell" through the single live region; ArrowDown+Enter focused the Cell editor (tab); "No matching cells" then Escape restored all 4 entries

Cell insert, move, delete, undo [CELL-01]: insert focused the new editor; move kept editor focus; delete focused the following Cell and offered Undo; Undo restored 5 Cells with focus on the restored Cell's heading
editor mode switch [CELL-03, A11Y-02]: Left/Right moved the tab-list roving focus; Enter activated Description; Home returned to Source, both with aria-selected tracking

generation and cancellation [DRAFT-01]: generate locked Source, Add Cell, and Document details while the outline stayed usable and focus moved to Cancel; cancelling restored Description focus and kept the Pending Description

Draft Gate [DRAFT-01, DRAFT-02, DRAFT-03]: generation produced a valid Draft Gate with Apply disabled-until-valid and a review affordance; Discard returned to Description with the Pending Description and identical Source; Apply replaced the Source (59 → 50 chars), focused its start (0-0), and announced
front matter boundary [CELL-02]: pasted front matter was stripped to "# Body only" and announced; Document details stayed "Document basics" / "AzeForge examples" / "2026-09-28"

generation responses [DRAFT-04]: clarification ("Which audience should this target?") offered Revise Description and kept the Pending Description; refusal offered Dismiss; provider failure offered Return to Description — none opened a Draft Gate

preview refresh, sizing, expansion [PREVIEW-01, PREVIEW-04, PREVIEW-05]: load 0, a Theme change +0, a Source edit +0 and expansion +0 submitted jobs; the single Refresh submitted one html compile (reaching "current"); separator moved from 252 through Home 180 and End 540 to 524; the expanded preview shared the Artifact, contained focus, and Escape restored #refresh-preview

preview failure retains the Artifact [PREVIEW-03]: a refresh over an invalid document reported "Preview blocked by Source errors" and kept the previous Artifact visible with the diagnostics action, without discarding or re-fetching it

diagnostics navigation [DOC-02, DOC-01]: a warning-only analysis left the dock closed (summary "0 error · 1 warning") while expanding Document details and marking the Date field invalid with described feedback; the summary trigger opened the dock with heading focus and Tab could leave it; Escape closed it and restored #diagnostics-toggle; activating the entry focused the Date field; an error analysis (16 error · 16 warning) revealed the dock and retained focus on the initiating surface (#more-toggle)

format review [FORMAT-01]: Format opened a compiler-labelled "Formatted Source" review with focus inside and the Source untouched; Escape discarded nothing and restored the invoking control; Apply replaced the Source and focused it
menus [A11Y-01]: menus open on the first item (Tab-walked), Home/End/ArrowUp move and wrap, and Escape restored each exact trigger (#more-toggle, #export-toggle) with aria-expanded false

export [EXPORT-01, EXPORT-02]: Export opened on the first item with 4 capability-advertised formats; the chosen item showed per-item progress then "SVG export complete" with one download and focus back on the trigger; it compiled the current Source (330 chars) with theme default (omitted) in format svg, independent of the preview Artifact (loaded); the error fixture blocked export (item "HTML — failed"), revealed diagnostics without taking focus (#export-toggle), and downloaded nothing — keyboard throughout
service dialog [SERVICE-01]: health opened progressively disclosed details (rail label "Service details: healthy") with focus inside; Escape closed it and restored the trigger
preview frame navigation [A11Y-02]: Tab reached the rendered preview frame and left it again, continuing to preview-separator — no iframe trap
